info.name: Cam Pha GIS API
info.description:
## Cam Pha GIS API

**Import xong dung ngay — khong can cau hinh them.**

baseUrl va tat ca tai khoan da nhung san trong Collection Variables. Khi gui request admin, token tu dong lay neu chua co (pre-request auto-login). Hoac chay thu cong qua folder **Dang nhap theo vai tro** de lay du 5 token cung luc.

### Tai khoan (seed san trong DB local)

| Role | Email | Quyen noi bat |
|---|---|---|
| system_admin | admin@campha.gov.vn | Nhat ky, toan quyen CMS |
| ubnd_tp | ubnd@campha.gov.vn | Xem user & lop ban do |
| so_tnmt | tnmt@campha.gov.vn | Toan quyen lop & user |
| so_xd | xaydung@campha.gov.vn | Xem & export lop, quan ly user |
| citizen | citizen@campha.gov.vn | Chi xem du lieu cong khai |

**Mat khau chung:** `CamPha@2026`

### Rate limit
| Nhom | Gioi han | Cua so |
|---|---|---|
| Tat ca /api/ | 1000 req | 15 phut |
| Auth | 20 req | 15 phut |
| Quen/dat lai mat khau | 5 req | 15 phut |
| Web Map & Map Proxy | 120 req | 1 phut |

### Response envelope
```
// Thanh cong
{ "message": "...", "status": 200, "data": { ... } }
// Danh sach
{ ..., "data": { "items": [...] }, "metadata": { "page", "limit", "total" } }
// Loi
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": [] }
```

item.name: Xac thuc 2 buoc MFA
item.description:
Luong MFA voi Google Authenticator.

**Thu tu:** Login -> nhan challengeToken -> MFA Setup -> MFA Confirm -> MFA Verify khi dang nhap lan sau.

Buoc 2: Xac nhan ma TOTP 6 chu so de kich hoat MFA. Tra ve danh sach recovery codes.
